name: ThinkingPill
intent: Inline indicator that an agent is processing before any output appears; mount/unmount for the request-started → first-token window.
when: Signal an agent is working before its first response token

chooseOver.because: Spinner is a generic loader; ThinkingPill is the labeled agent-turn 'thinking' affordance

extracted: cva variants/sizes remain generated by the structural extractor

lineage.confidence: unset — projection round-trip verified; no held-out eval yet

props.name: label
props.description: Label. Keep to ~3 words. Defaults to "Thinking".

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading icon. Defaults to a Brain glyph that pairs with the default "Thinking" label.

props.name: ...props
props.description: All standard HTML attributes are supported.

usage: Use ThinkingPill to enhance your user interface. This component provides a consistent, accessible, and well-designed solution for this use case.
ThinkingPill integrates seamlessly with other components in the design system. Follow the established patterns and guidelines to ensure consistency across your application.

anatomy.description: ThinkingPill is composed of the following parts:

bestPractices.title: Use semantic props
bestPractices.description: Use the component's built-in props rather than className overrides.

bestPractices.title: Don't override core styles
bestPractices.description: Avoid using className to override the component's fundamental styling.

bestPractices.title: Provide accessible labels
bestPractices.description: Include proper ARIA labels for screen reader users.

bestPractices.title: Don't skip accessibility
bestPractices.description: Never omit accessibility attributes for interactive components.

bestPractices.title: Handle all states
bestPractices.description: Account for loading, error, empty, and success states.

bestPractices.title: Don't ignore edge cases
bestPractices.description: Avoid showing broken UI when data is missing or loading.
